title: Separate similar pairs
hook: Two almost identical labels need a distinguishing cue.

knows: reading short labels and comparing simple counts
doesNotKnow: Check the specific difference between two arbitrary codes.

objective: Check the specific difference between two arbitrary codes.

claims.text: Scenario, hook and prediction: Two almost identical labels need a distinguishing cue. Which notes distinguish these codes? Correct option: Code plus distinguishing field. All fixture labels, example words, dates, task durations and file fields are stipulated exercise data.
claims.source: Explicit exercise fixture in src/lib/lifehacks/studyCatalog.ts and pure rules in studyModels.ts. All times, sizes, deadlines and outcomes describe this exercise only; no empirical productivity or learning effect is inferred. FC LH-1 (session 2, received by message): verified; see company/reviews/lifehacks-200/fact-check-LH1-2026-10-14.md.

claims.text: The last digit distinguishes the two codes in the fixture. The same shared description would not identify which code was intended.
